subject: Re: Equinor SIG & SOC 2 evidence — evidence routing and contract redlines
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@equinor.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@equinor.com
Date: 2027-05-05T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Equinor SIG questionnaire — clarification and evidence requests

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the SIG packet — Equinor's InfoSec team combed through and we have a few clarifying asks before we proceed to a formal review:

- We need a mapping table that links your SIG control IDs to specific SOC 2 control objectives and any ISO 27001 clauses you reference. A single spreadsheet that crosswalks SIG -> SOC2 -> ISO would be ideal.
- Evidence delivery: can you indicate where the artifacts live (S3 path or Drive) and provide short-lived links or a process to access them?
- Contract: procurement has a handful of redline suggestions (mainly around data residency and audit rights). Is someone on your legal/contracts team available to review next week?

Can we get the control map and a point of contact for access by EOD Wednesday (May 5)? We are trying to keep the review on this sprint.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Vendor Security Lead — Equinor
[Attachment: equinor_sig_questions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@equinor.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Equinor SIG questionnaire — clarification and evidence requests

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask.

Summary of what we are sending now (attached):
- redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx: crosswalk SIG controls -> SOC 2 criteria -> ISO 27001 clauses, with authoritative evidence filenames in the right column.
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf: short narrative of our SOC 2 scope and where to find the report artifacts.

Access: artifacts are staged in a shared Drive folder (link below) and we can provide short-lived S3 presigned links for any large logs or archived bundles. Sergio will be the access owner — I've CC'd him. Markus will handle the crypto/KMS evidence.

Next steps:
1) Review the spreadsheet and call out any missing mappings by Thursday 5/6.
2) If procurement has contract redlines, please send them to me and our legal lead (I'll loop them in) and we'll propose a response timeline.

Attaching the files now; happy to do a 30-minute walkthrough Friday if that helps.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (pdf)]

Related Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-equinor-sig

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@equinor.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Equinor SIG questionnaire — clarification and evidence requests

Elena / team — quick technical notes to help with the evidence walk:

- Evidence locations and what to expect in the Drive folder:
  * /equinor-sig/artifacts/soc2/ — SOC 2 report (redacted where appropriate), control narratives, and test procedures.
  * /equinor-sig/artifacts/telemetry/ — sampling of production telemetry (redacted IPs) and retention logs.
  * /equinor-sig/artifacts/kms/ — key rotation screenshots and KMS policy exports (we will provide HSM attestation excerpt).

- For large archival bundles (>500MB) we'll provide presigned S3 links valid for 72 hours. Please flag which files you'd like and approximate times you will access them.

- On data residency: our platform supports region pinning for inference workloads. For Equinor we recommend the Frankfurt region for low-latency EU hosting. Detailed network diagrams are in the Drive.

I'll be available on the walkthrough Friday and can demo artifact retrieval from the staging bucket if helpful.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: procurement@equinor.com
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@equinor.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract redlines and data residency questions

Hi Kimberly — procurement here. We circulated a redline set (see attached) that includes: tighter audit-rights language, explicit EU data residency obligations, and a clause about subprocessor disclosure cadence. Please confirm who will review these redlines from Redwood legal and an expected turnaround.

Also: is there a standard SOC 2 external auditor contact you can share (name and firm) for our risk team?

Thanks,
Equinor Procurement Team
[Attachment: equinor_redlines_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Equinor Procurement <procurement@equinor.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@equinor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T11:56:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract redlines and data residency questions

Thanks for the redlines — quick technical confirmation on the items that touch controls: 

- Encryption at rest/in transit: We use AES-256 at rest and TLS1.3 in transit. KMS is customer-key-capable; for Private deployments we can support a customer-managed HSM. Evidence: see /equinor-sig/artifacts/kms/redwood_kms_rotation_2027-01-01.txt and the HSM attestation excerpt in the Drive.
- Subprocessors: we publish a quarterly list; the latest export is in the Drive (subprocessors_2027Q1.csv).
- Soc2 auditor: we engaged BrightShield LLP for our last SOC 2 Type II cycle; contact: Jenna Cole, BrightShield (jenna.cole@brightshield.com).

On the residency ask: to operationalize EU-only inference we can provide a regional routing policy and a signed SOW addendum documenting the scope. Kimberly — please confirm if legal should generate the SOW addendum or if procurement prefers a redline to the master agreement.

Markus Klein
Director, Applied Cryptography — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: kms_evidence_notes.txt (txt)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@equinor.com>, procurement@equinor.com
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Equinor SIG & SOC 2 evidence — evidence routing and contract redlines

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Consolidated next steps and commitments: 

1) Evidence delivery: we placed the requested artifacts in the shared Drive folder and pre-staged three large bundles in S3. Sergio will send presigned links after you confirm which bundles you need (ETA: 72-hour links once requested).
2) Control crosswalk: redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx (attached earlier) is our authoritative mapping. If you identify a specific SIG control that needs additional artifactation, please highlight the line and we'll add the artifact reference.
3) Contract: we've created an initial response to your redlines — see attached document equinor_redlines_v1.docx. Our legal team prefers to start with a short SOW addendum for the EU-residency and then reconcile any master agreement language. I will loop in our legal counsel after you confirm your preferred route.
4) SOC 2 auditor contact: BrightShield LLP (Jenna Cole) — Markus included contact details above.

Proposed timeline: evidence handoff this week, legal response to procurement redlines by 5/19. Please confirm availability for a 30-minute walkthrough on Friday 5/15 at 09:00 CET / 11:00 CET — we can host a recording.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: equinor_redlines_v1.docx (docx)]
